title: Regreening the desert with John D. Liu | VPRO Documentary | 2012
summary: A VPRO documentary following ecologist and cameraman John D. Liu. He documents the regreening of China's Loess Plateau and other efforts to restore deserts and biodiversity around the world.
why: HN cites it as the best-documented example of landscape-scale restoration working, with striking before and after footage from the Loess Plateau.

quote.text: I've seen a documentary with some before and after video footage. Quite amazing difference
